title: Functional fine-mapping of the 9p21.3 cardiovascular disease locus implicates the lncRNA MIR31HG as an effector transcript in endothelial cells
authors: Zhigulev A; Poujade F; Gryzunov N; Buyan A; Li H; Bergman O; Liu M; Pradhananga S; Franco-Cereceda A; Swoboda P; Kulakovskiy IV; Eriksson P; Sahlén P; Björck HM
one_liner_zh: 该文用启动子捕获Hi-C和AlphaGenome等工具定位9p21.3心血管病位点的长程染色质互作与增强子调控，涉及染色质空间组织但以实验为主、AI/模拟方法仅作辅助，建模深度有限。
abstract:
BACKGROUND

The chromosome 9p21.3 locus is among the strongest genetic risk loci for cardiovascular disease (CVD), yet the regulatory mechanisms underlying this association remain poorly understood. Previous vascular disease studies focused predominantly on the role of this locus in smooth muscle cell (SMC) dysfunction, whereas its potential role in endothelial cells (ECs) remains less well characterized. Here, we sought to identify candidate regulatory variants at 9p21.3, their distal target genes, and effector transcripts that contribute to CVD-related phenotypes in ECs.

METHODS

Promoter capture Hi-C was used to map chromatin interactions at 9p21.3 in primary human ascending aortic SMCs (n=6), supplementing the previously obtained ECs (n=16) dataset. To support the regulatory relevance of these interactions, expression quantitative trait locus analysis was performed in 136 vascular biopsies. Variant effects were prioritized in silico using AlphaGenome. The regulatory activity of the prioritized region was validated using CRISPR activation.

RESULTS

Chromatin interaction mapping identified a complex regulatory architecture at the 9p21.3 locus involving 19 putative regulatory elements and 15 genes across ECs and SMCs. MIR31HG showed the most recurrent distal promoter connectivity with the 9p21.3 region. Consistent with the chromatin interaction map, expression of MIR31HG transcripts was associated with genetic variation at the 9p21.3 locus. In ECs, the lncRNA MIR31HG, but not miR-31, was responsive to hemodynamic flow. Depletion of MIR31HG in ECs was associated with endothelial activation. Epigenetic tracks and deep learning predictions highlighted an active enhancer element at 9p21.3, which was subsequently validated by CRISPR activation and increased MIR31HG expression, confirming its capacity to regulate MIR31HG over a large genomic distance of approximately 538 kb.

CONCLUSIONS

Altogether, these data implicate lncRNA MIR31HG as a likely effector of the 9p21.3 CVD locus, linking the cis-regulatory element and heritable genetic variation in the respective region to endothelial activation through long-range enhancer regulation.

Clinical Perspective

What Is New? Promoter capture Hi-C in primary human vascular cells identified recurrent long-range interactions between the 9p21.3 cardiovascular disease locus and the MIR31HG promoter, extending the regulatory landscape beyond the nearest genes. Expression of MIR31HG transcripts was associated with 9p21.3 genetic variation in vascular tissue; the lncRNA MIR31HG was responsive to hemodynamic flow in endothelial cells and influenced the endothelial activation transcriptional programs upon depletion. Integrated sequence-based, epigenomic, genetic, and CRISPR activation analyses nominated the 9p21.3 enhancer as a regulator of MIR31HG in endothelial cells. What Are the Clinical Implications? The findings suggest that the cardiovascular disease associations of 9p21.3 may involve stronger than previously anticipated endothelial regulatory mechanisms in addition to characterized effects in other vascular cell types. lncRNA MIR31HG provides a molecular link between noncoding genetic variation at 9p21.3 and endothelial cell-state regulation relevant to vascular disease.
abstract_zh:
背景

染色体9p21.3位点是心血管疾病（CVD）最强的遗传风险位点之一，然而该关联背后的调控机制仍知之甚少。以往的血管疾病研究主要集中在该位点在平滑肌细胞（SMC）功能障碍中的作用，而其在内皮细胞（ECs）中的潜在作用仍未得到充分表征。在此，我们旨在识别9p21.3处的候选调控变异、其远端靶基因以及在内皮细胞中促成CVD相关表型的效应转录本。

方法

使用启动子捕获Hi-C技术绘制原代人升主动脉SMCs（n=6）中9p21.3处的染色质相互作用，补充先前获得的ECs（n=16）数据集。为支持这些相互作用的调控相关性，在136例血管活检中进行了表达数量性状位点分析。使用AlphaGenome在计算机上优先排序变异效应。通过CRISPR激活验证了优先排序区域的调控活性。

结果

染色质相互作用作图识别出9p21.3位点处涉及19个推定调控元件和15个基因（在ECs和SMCs中）的复杂调控架构。MIR31HG显示出与9p21.3区域最频繁的远端启动子连接。与染色质相互作用图一致，MIR31HG转录本的表达与9p21.3位点的遗传变异相关。在内皮细胞中，lncRNA MIR31HG（而非miR-31）对血流动力学流动有响应。内皮细胞中MIR31HG的耗竭与内皮激活相关。表观遗传学轨道和深度学习预测突出了9p21.3处的一个活性增强子元件，随后通过CRISPR激活验证并增加了MIR31HG表达，确认其在大约538 kb的大基因组距离上调控MIR31HG的能力。

结论

总体而言，这些数据表明lncRNA MIR31HG可能是9p21.3 CVD位点的效应因子，通过长距离增强子调控将相应区域中的顺式调控元件和可遗传遗传变异与内皮激活联系起来。

临床视角

有何新发现？在原代人血管细胞中的启动子捕获Hi-C识别出9p21.3心血管疾病位点与MIR31HG启动子之间的频繁长距离相互作用，将调控景观扩展到最近基因之外。MIR31HG转录本的表达与血管组织中9p21.3遗传变异相关；lncRNA MIR31HG对内皮细胞中的血流动力学流动有响应，并在耗竭时影响内皮激活转录程序。整合的基于序列、表观基因组、遗传和CRISPR激活分析提名9p21.3增强子为内皮细胞中MIR31HG的调控因子。临床意义是什么？研究结果表明，9p21.3的心血管疾病关联可能涉及比以前预期更强的内皮调控机制，此外还有其他血管细胞类型中已表征的效应。lncRNA MIR31HG提供了9p21.3非编码遗传变异与内皮细胞状态调控之间的分子联系，这与血管疾病相关。
